key_terms: Line of Sight: Straight line drawn from observer's eye to the point in the object being viewed.
Angle of Elevation: Angle between line of sight and horizontal level when looking upward at an object above horizontal level.
Angle of Depression: Angle between line of sight and horizontal level when looking downward at an object below horizontal level.
Problem-solving strategy: Modeling real-life objects (towers, poles, trees, buildings) as right-angled triangles and using tan, sin, or cos ratios to find heights or distances.
